Let \(x=a_2-a_1\) and \(y=a_3-a_2\). Then the conditions give:
\[
x\ge 3,\quad y\ge 1,\quad a_1+x+y\le 10.
\]
Set \(x'=x-3,\ y'=y-1,\ a_1'=a_1-1\). Then
\[
a_1'+x'+y'\le 5,
\]
with \(a_1',x',y'\ge 0\). The number of nonnegative triples with sum \(\le 5\) is
\[
\binom{5+3}{3}=\binom{8}{3}=56.
\]

\[
\boxed{56}
\]
